messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 5):
"""
vii. all types of Hospitals and Health Care Providers to suit the affordability of the policyholders/prospects. Policyholder shall not be denied coverage in case of emergency situations. Note: The above does not imply that the Insurer shall have one product to cater to all of the above b. Insurers shall allow for customization of products by customer by providing the flexibility to choose products/add-ons/riders as per his/her medical conditions/specific needs. 2) Products are available to cover Technological Advancements & Treatments: Insurers shall endeavour to cover Technological Advancements and Treatments in their products. Examples of prevalent treatment / procedures that need to be included, and not limited to the following: a. Uterine Artery Embolization and HIFU b. Balloon Sinuplasty c. Deep Brain stimulation d. Oral chemotherapy e. Immunotherapy- Monoclonal Antibody to be given as injection f. Intra vitreal injections g.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Can I customize my health insurance policy with add-ons or riders based on my medical needs?","answer":"Yes, insurers must allow customers to customize their products by choosing add-ons or riders that suit their medical conditions or specific needs.","facts":["Insurers shall allow for customization of products by customer by providing the flexibility to choose products/add-ons/riders as per his/her medical conditions/specific needs"]},{"question":"Will my insurer cover advanced treatments such as immunotherapy monoclonal antibody injections?","answer":"Yes, insurers are required to cover technological advancements and treatments, including immunotherapy monoclonal antibody injections.","facts":["Products are available to cover Technological Advancements & Treatments: Insurers shall endeavour to cover Technological Advancements and Treatments in their products.","Immunotherapy- Monoclonal Antibody to be given as injection"]}]}
